content.what_it_is: MATLAB bathymetry generator for the FUNWAVE-TVD rain_on_hills case producing depth_656x200.txt. Starts from a flat depth dep_flat=2.0 on a 656x200 grid (L2-L8). With fixed seed rng(2) (L21), scatters three groups of square patches (sizes 60, 70, 80 points, 6 each; L18-L19) with random lower-left corners inside a window starting at xstart=250 with widths widthx=350, widthy=150 (L13-L16, L22-L27). Each patch is filled with MATLAB's peaks(size) surface and accumulated into sum_zzz (L37-L49); figure 1 draws the patch rectangles (L31-L44). Negative accumulations are clipped to 0 (L51), the field is min-max normalized (L53-L55), and hills are carved out of the flat depth by dep=dep-sum_zzz*dep_flat/rat with rat=1.005 (L57; an earlier rat=1.1 'first test, no instability' is commented at L6). Figure 2 shows normalized topography and bathymetry pcolors, saved to ./plots/depth_pcolor.jpg (L61-L79). A planar slope 10.0-0.03*(i-1) per column is added to dep (L81-L88), figure 3 mesh view saved to ./plots/depth_mesh.jpg (L90-L103), figure 4 1D profiles saved to ./plots/depth_1d.jpg (L105-L111), and the final field is saved as ASCII depth_656x200.txt (L113).
entities: x0, x1, y0, y1 patch corner cell arrays L23-L26
xx1, xx2, yy1, yy2 patch corners L40-L43

equations.ref: random patch x corners, seeded rng(2) L21

calls: ylabel L70, L76, L77, L99, L108
unresolved: with dep_flat=2 and rat=1.005 the deepest hill crest reaches dep=2-2/1.005=0.00995 before the slope is added, keeping cells barely wet; after adding slope values 10.0 down to 10.0-0.03*655=-9.65 (L85) the right part of the domain becomes negative depth (dry hills), consistent with the rain_on_hills case name, but intended still-water datum is not documented

patch placement can exceed array bounds only if xstart+widthx+max(sizes) > m; here 250+350+80=680 > m=656, so an out-of-bounds write at L46 is possible for unlucky rand draws; with rng(2) the actual draws evidently fit, but the script is not generally safe
k=30 (L4) is never used; second ylabel at L77 overwrites the first and labels the y-axis 'points in x' on a y axis; figure 1 (patch rectangles) is never printed (L59 commented)
